decision: The narrow unresolved-classical-scope hold is enforced before submission. Other reviewed new SAN contexts show no concrete blocker. Revision includes no new rule or recipe-rule context beyond the bounded reviewed set and prior source audits.
limitations: Rule-ID coverage and successful regeneration are not independent certification of every complete form or every variant. Systematic new disagreements still require outcome-independent source review; preserve all raw data. No source-based harder-item selection.
subsequent_finding: Independent review of contexts absent from immediate predecessor (although present broader history) identified caN-conditioned7.4.7 misapplication before san. Scope21 now holds this context; no paid model answers exist.
